title: Crashed Thargoid Scout #3
excerpt: A crashed Thargoid Scout can be found on Arietis Sector ZE-A d75 body 10 a, located at 18.0215, 132.8716 (in Live/4.0) or at 18.0145, 131.9288 (in Legacy/3.8).The crash site is surrounded by Thargoid Technology Samples, Thargoid Biological Matter, and Thargoid Resin.
